recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, cinematic family portrait set in a weathered, brown-walled room. A man in the foreground, seen from the back-profile wearing a crown of thorns and a handgun tucked into his waistband, holds a young child. In the background, a woman sits on a bed nursing an infant. The scene blends sacred symbolism with harsh domestic reality.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground man with crown of thorns vs. background nursing mother
Pristine white garments vs. distressed, peeling brown walls
Protective parental embrace vs. the presence of a concealed weapon
Natural window light vs. deep, heavy shadows in room corners
coreInvariants: Crown of thorns as a central symbolic headpiece
Handgun visible in the rear waistband of the trousers
Peeling plaster patches on a dark ochre/brown wall
White t-shirts and tank tops providing high-value contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man and child occupy the left foreground at a medium-close scale; the woman and infant are positioned in the right background at a medium-full scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's white t-shirt and the crown of thorns serve as the primary focal point due to brightness and sharp detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the crown of thorns down to the child's face, across to the nursing mother, and finally to the weapon in the waistband.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space in the upper third and right edge of the frame emphasizes the claustrophobic domestic setting.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep ochre and chocolate brown walls provide a warm, somber base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white clothing creates sharp, clean breaks in the muddy environment.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Tan/khaki trousers and beige bedding bridge the gap between white and brown.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and desaturated skin tones

graphicDevices: Hard directional lighting from the left

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photograph of a room with peeling brown walls and a white radiator. A man with a crown of thorns and a gun in his waistband holds a child in the foreground. A woman sits on a bed in the background nursing a baby. Use 35mm film aesthetic with natural side lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, centered serif font in white at the bottom or top margin to maintain the cinematic feel.

verificationChecks: Is the crown of thorns clearly visible?
Is the handgun visible in the waistband?
Are the walls appropriately distressed with peeling patches?
Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Depth of field between foreground and background subjects
Warmth of the brown color palette
mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain film-like texture
Ensure the crown of thorns looks realistic and integrated, not like a costume
Maintain the somber, serious emotional tone
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between the man and the child's weight
Verify the nursing pose looks natural and not staged
Ensure the weapon is tucked realistically into the belt line
Confirm the white clothing isn't blown out/losing detail
Check that the crown of thorns sits naturally on the head
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine religious martyrdom symbols with gritty urban domesticity using a 35mm film aesthetic, centered on a palette of deep browns and stark whites.
